title: Required documents.
officialText:
The applicant shall submit all of the documents specified in Sections 106.3 through 106.10 as
appropriate to the nature and extent of the work proposed. Construction documents shall indicate the plumbing work to be
performed, so drawn as to conform to the architectural and structural aspects of the building and to show in detail compli ance with
this code.
